Complete syntax/schema/formal-rule validation has not been run by Stage 1.
No approved expected dimensions/grid/schedule has been supplied.
No labelled drawing or reference model has been supplied.
This is a prototype extraction profile, not project acceptance or standards certification.

post_processing.scope: Recomputed engine comparison against web-ifc 128-segment evidence and classified failures using raw IFC inspection. Backend geometry measurements and extraction timings retained from the exhaustive run.

browser_geometry_evidence.measurement_scope: World bounds and triangulated surface/volume diagnostics; not complete shape equivalence or manifold certification.
browser_geometry_evidence.axis_mapping: web-ifc Y-up normalized to IFC Z-up [x,-z,y], recentering reversed

browser_gpu_validation.message: No installed Chromium binary in local execution workspace; cloud browser refused local127.0.0.1 with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT. User-machine Windows/GPU verification remains outstanding.
